R1.rule: When invoking any feature-dev:* subagent (code-architect, code-explorer, code-reviewer) via the Agent tool, always pass model: "opus" as an explicit argument.

R2.rule: Every Agent tool call with subagent_type "feature-dev:<name>" must include model: "opus".

R4.rule: If the feature-dev agents are still set to sonnet in their frontmatter, keep passing the model: "opus" override.

R5.rule: If the user relies heavily on the feature-dev skill, tell them that skill-internal dispatches of feature-dev agents will not receive the opus override and will default to sonnet.

R6.rule: Never dismiss production warnings that mean features are broken as "non-fatal"; treat broken features as broken.

R7.rule: When a feature is broken, call it broken and fix it rather than downplaying it.

R8.rule: When reviewing logs, validation output, or audit findings, escalate anything that will cause a user-facing runtime failure to an error, regardless of how the code currently classifies it.

R9.rule: When reviewing logs, validation output, or audit findings, trace the consequence chain ahead and flag the root cause.

R10.rule: When someone re-asks whether all agents run Opus 4.7 with effort max, point them to the audit memory and its two linked memories.

R11.rule: When someone re-asks whether all agents run Opus 4.7 with effort max, do not re-run the agent model audit.

R12.rule: Rebuild the agent model/effort audit snapshot when a new plugin is installed.

R13.rule: Rebuild the agent model/effort audit snapshot when /reload-plugins runs after a plugin update.

R14.rule: Rebuild the agent model/effort audit snapshot when a project-level agent is added under .claude/agents/.

R15.rule: Rebuild the agent model/effort audit snapshot when the user reports a subagent that feels off-model.

R16.rule: Do not modify plugin cache files to fix agent model configuration.

R17.rule: Do not modify .claude/settings.json to fix agent model configuration.

R18.rule: Do not modify CLAUDE.md to fix agent model configuration; use the memory layer instead.

R19.rule: If a subagent's output feels lower-effort than expected, revisit the assumption that session-level /effort max propagates to subagents before anything else.

R20.rule: Push back on bad decisions when working as the agent on this project.

R21.rule: Think ahead about likely consequences and future needs when working on this project.

R22.rule: Trace problems to their root causes instead of treating only their symptoms.

R23.rule: Never dismiss issues raised by the user or discovered during work; address or explicitly flag them.

R24.rule: When suggesting high-frequency churn zones (such as Toyota HQ at lunch), only make the suggestion when the driver's energy is high.

R25.rule: Remind the driver not to let empathy for rural passengers pull them into unprofitable deadhead trips.

R26.rule: Do not clear output when the user changes tabs.

R28.rule: Avoid recommending Waco or Oklahoma trips.

R29.rule: For private ride routing, prefer smooth movement (DNT) over the shortest distance to avoid braking and discomfort.

R30.rule: In the early morning, prefer deadheading back to Frisco over waiting in the early AM queue.

R31.rule: When recommending nightlife spots, prefer safe upscale Latin dance venues such as Gloria's or New West.

R32.rule: At 7:30 AM, when West Frisco is dead, direct the driver to the SH-121 highway corridor, which has the lowest wait times.

R33.rule: Prefer waiting 15+ minutes in a hotspot for quality rides over driving 40 miles for an $18 UberX ride.

R34.rule: Use Opus 4.7 (1M context) for Claude Code sessions in this workspace.

R35.rule: Set the effort level to max (/effort max) for Claude Code sessions.

R36.rule: When spawning any subagent, use Opus 4.7 as the model, regardless of the plugin's declared default model.

R37.rule: When invoking subagents, prefer agents whose frontmatter declares model: opus or model: inherit.

R38.rule: When invoking feature-dev agents, apply the per-invocation model override described in the linked feedback memory.

R39.rule: When flagging that effort is not max at session start, do not block silently; flag it and proceed with the work.

R40.rule: Do not suggest using Sonnet or Haiku models for cost reasons.

R41.rule: Do not treat max effort as required for trivially lookup-style one-shot diagnostic questions.

R190.rule: Never create a branch with `git checkout -b` in the main checkout.

R191.rule: After a branch is merged, remove its worktree by running `pnpm worktree remove <branch>` from the main checkout.

R192.rule: The main controller must rewrite this handoff file before every context clear.

R193.rule: The main controller must rewrite this handoff file after every merge or dispatch.

R194.rule: Keep the controller handoff file short.

R195.rule: When adding a new entry to the controller handoff file, move older entries down below it.

R196.rule: Prune entries from the controller handoff file once they no longer matter.

R197.rule: Never create or enter a PAT or interactive OAuth credential for an MCP server; the user must do that step.

R198.rule: Keep the .mcp.json file untracked (do not commit it to version control).

R199.rule: When an MCP tool that needs a PAT or OAuth login is not connected, check its environment variable or the CLI's `whoami` output before blaming the config.

R200.rule: When an MCP tool needs a manual one-time credential or login step, tell the user the exact step (URL or command) instead of attempting it yourself.

R201.rule: Use preview_start to view the main checkout when capturing the "before" picture of a change.

R202.rule: Call preview_stop after capturing the main checkout's "before" picture.

R203.rule: To check a branch in a worktree, run `pnpm dev` from the worktree in the background.

R204.rule: To view a worktree's dev server in the browser pane, open it with preview_start using the url "http://localhost:<port>", where the port is the worktree's dev server port.

R205.rule: After checking a branch in the browser pane, stop the worktree's dev server.

R206.rule: After checking a branch in the browser pane, stop any leftover `next … start-server` process so the port is free.

R207.rule: Do not edit the main checkout's .claude/launch.json to get a worktree branch into the browser pane.

R208.rule: Before running `git checkout -- <file>` to undo a break-the-code test, copy the file aside first so your uncommitted edits to it are not lost.

R209.rule: Borrow ideas from the uiverse galaxy snippets when making pages livelier.

R210.rule: Never paste code from the uiverse galaxy snippets into the project.

R211.rule: When using an effect from the uiverse galaxy snippets, rebuild it using this repo's tokens.

R212.rule: When rebuilding a snippet effect, handle prefers-reduced-motion.

R213.rule: When rebuilding a snippet effect, handle accessibility.

R214.rule: When rebuilding a snippet effect, use the impeccable skill's `animate` and `delight` guidance.

R215.rule: To scan the uiverse galaxy repo, clone it shallowly into the scratchpad.

R216.rule: On Windows, scan the uiverse galaxy repo with a Node script instead of a per-file shell loop.
